note: 2026-09-27 Unit 6 rebuild (user direction: rebuild Units 5-7 through the engine, new photos approved). Learn holds leaves and arrives. Each schedule card shows the vehicle, the time and an arrow away from or into the station, and each pair changes only the time or only leaves/arrives. Days of the week come back only in Speak and Use (the cards do not show a day, so no choice depends on one).

lesson.title: 6.8 Schedules
lesson.unit_outcome: Name places in town and ways to travel, say where places are, give simple directions, say what you can and cannot do, ask for help, and read simple bus and train times.
lesson.goal: Understand when a bus or a train leaves or arrives, and add the part of the day or the day of the week.
lesson.grammar_function: The bus leaves at eight. The train arrives at nine. The bus leaves at eight on Monday.
lesson.prerequisite: 4.9 days; 4.10 at and parts of the day; 6.2 train; 2.6-2.7 numbers.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say when a bus or a train leaves or arrives.
